info.title: obin/authority/v1/module_authority.proto
info.description:
Extracted from the host (codefly-dev/module-saas-starter,
saas/accounts/v1/module_registration.proto and module_capabilities.proto) on
2026-10-21 with messages, fields and field numbers unchanged. The host serves
these two operations on its ModuleCapabilitiesService beside operations a
module never calls; the interface carries only what a module relies on, under
a service of its own.
